stories.title: La Fête des vendanges, le Jour de la douleur des primes maladie et la Foire du Valais?

en.title: The Grape Harvest Festival, the Day of Pain for Health Insurance Premiums and the Valais Fair?
en.summary: A columnist examines whether rising health insurance premiums are an inevitable consequence of increasing healthcare costs, questioning whether this spiral is truly unavoidable in policy discussions.

stories.title: Arbeit statt Gefängnis – In Zürich arbeiten immer mehr Menschen Geldstrafen ab

en.title: Work Instead of Prison – More People in Zurich Working Off Fines
en.summary: A cantonal support office established a year ago helps affected individuals work off monetary penalties rather than serving jail time, with authorities reporting success in the program.

stories.title: Regierungs- und Parlamentswahl – Nationalistische Kräfte bleiben in Bosnien-Herzegowina stark

en.title: Government and Parliamentary Elections – Nationalist Forces Remain Strong in Bosnia and Herzegovina
en.summary: Following elections in Bosnia and Herzegovina, nationalist parties maintained their political position while voter turnout reached a record low.

stories.title: Flugzeug über dem Atlantik verschwunden: Suche nach vermissten Insassen eingestellt

en.title: Aircraft Disappears Over Atlantic: Search for Missing Passengers Discontinued
en.summary: A small aircraft carrying six people traveling from Bermuda to Boston disappeared from radar off Massachusetts. The search has ended following discovery of wreckage from the plane.

stories.title: Abdul El-Sayed, le professeur d’épidémiologie musulman qui fait trembler les conservateurs du Michigan

en.title: Abdul El-Sayed, Muslim epidemiology professor shaking up Michigan conservatives
en.summary: Abdul El-Sayed, an epidemiology professor, won the Democratic nomination for Michigan senator and is considered a frontrunner in the upcoming midterm elections. He remains popular with the left but must broaden his appeal to centrist voters to win this pivotal state.

stories.title: Les bombardiers américains retirés de la base militaire de Fairford en Angleterre après un incident

en.title: American bombers withdrawn from Fairford military base in England following incident
en.summary: The United States withdrew B-1 bombers from the British military base at Fairford following a late September incident that triggered a counterterrorism investigation. The Pentagon stated the aircraft will be redeployed to their original U.S. bases.

stories.title: Milorad Dodik revendique la victoire de son parti dans l'entité serbe de Bosnie

en.title: Milorad Dodik claims victory for his party in Bosnian Serb entity
en.summary: Milorad Dodik, the former pro-Russian leader of Bosnian Serb entity, announced his party retained power in Sunday's general elections. Voter turnout was notably lower than usual.

stories.title: Au Brésil, Flavio Bolsonaro et Lula s’affronteront dans un second tour aux lourds enjeux pour la région et Washington

en.title: In Brazil, Flavio Bolsonaro and Lula will face off in a second round with major stakes for the region and Washington
en.summary: Brazil's extreme-right presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro received 47 percent of Sunday's vote, narrowly leading incumbent president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. A runoff is expected to determine the country's leadership with significant regional and international implications.

stories.title: En Bosnie, Milorad Dodik annonce la victoire de son parti lors des élections générales

en.title: In Bosnia, Milorad Dodik announces his party's victory in general elections
en.summary: Milorad Dodik's party retained power in Bosnia's general elections held Sunday, securing its position in the collective presidency and parliament of Republika Srpska. Voter turnout was notably low in the election.

stories.title: Flavio Bolsonaro devance Lula et l'affrontera au second tour

en.title: Flavio Bolsonaro ahead of Lula and will face him in runoff
en.summary: Conservative Flavio Bolsonaro unexpectedly led the first round of Brazil's presidential election with over 47% of votes, surpassing incumbent leftist Lula who received 45%. A runoff is scheduled for October 25.

stories.title: Dans les rangs de l’UDC, Marcel Dettling et Sylvain Freymond renoncent à succéder à Guy Parmelin, qui se dit favorable à une femme pour sa succession

en.title: In UDC ranks, Marcel Dettling and Sylvain Freymond renounce running to succeed Guy Parmelin, who favors a woman for succession
en.summary: Two UDC politicians have withdrawn from consideration to fill the Federal Council seat left vacant by Guy Parmelin, who has expressed preference for a female successor and named three potential candidates.

stories.title: Papables évoqués à la succession de Guy Parmelin, Marcel Dettling et Sylvain Freymond renoncent

en.title: Potential successors to Guy Parmelin, Marcel Dettling and Sylvain Freymond withdraw
en.summary: UDC president Marcel Dettling and national councillor Sylvain Freymond have withdrawn from contention for Guy Parmelin's Federal Council seat. Freymond prefers to focus on cantonal elections in 2027.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - Wir müssen uns nicht vor bösartiger Superintelligenz fürchten. Und doch gehen von KI-Agenten echte Gefahren aus

en.title: COMMENTARY - We need not fear malevolent superintelligence. Yet real dangers emanate from AI agents
en.summary: Concerns about superintelligent AI that could eliminate humanity are overblown and distract from the actual risks posed by AI companies developing and selling unsafe systems, though alternatives exist.

stories.title: Hedge-Funds halten so viele US-Staatsanleihen wie noch nie: Bei einem Crash wirken sie als Brandbeschleuniger

en.title: Hedge funds hold US Treasury bonds at record levels: In a crash they act as accelerants
en.summary: Interest rates on US debt have reached their highest level in nearly two decades, with hedge funds and other short-term speculators increasingly replacing long-term investors in the market.

stories.title: Der Stromhunger von Amazon, Google und Microsoft für Rechenzentren forciert den Bau von Mini-Atomkraftwerken in den USA

en.title: The power hunger of Amazon, Google and Microsoft for data centers is accelerating the construction of mini nuclear power plants in the USA
en.summary: Major technology companies are building small nuclear power plants next to their data centers in the United States to meet the substantial electricity demands of artificial intelligence facilities without straining the public grid.

stories.title: INTERVIEW - Tobias Becker: «Nostalgie ist zu einem Kampfbegriff geworden»

en.title: INTERVIEW - Tobias Becker: "Nostalgia has become a political battleground"
en.summary: Historian Tobias Becker disputes the common interpretation that right-wing populist movements like Brexit, Trump, and the AfD's success represent a reactionary retreat into the past.

stories.title: Pipelines statt Persischer Golf: Sieht so die Zukunft des Ölhandels aus?

en.title: Pipelines instead of the Persian Gulf: Is this the future of oil trade?
en.summary: While tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz is rising again, the United Arab Emirates is investing billions in pipeline infrastructure to bypass this critical chokepoint, though other Gulf states face greater challenges.
